institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry: requires 'A' Level passes in French and Government or History and any other Arts or Social Science subject.
Direct Entry: accepts NCE to include a pass in French, and accepts Baccalaureat de l'enseignement a merite secondaire or equivalent.
Direct Entry: UNIZIK, EKSU, JOS and UYO accept NCE plus 'O' Level credit pass in English Language.

Direct Entry: accepts a) NCE merit in two (2) relevant subjects as well as the UTME requirements; b) Two (2) passes at GCE 'A' Level/HSC or its equivalent, DALF certificate or an acceptable Baccalaureate Certificate in relevant subjects.
Direct Entry: accepts NCE with credit in French.

Direct Entry: accepts two (2) 'A' Level credit passes in French plus three (3) 'O' Level credits in three (3) subjects at not more than two (2) sittings; or three (3) 'A' Level passes plus two (2) 'O' Level credits in two (2) subjects at not more than two (2) sittings; also two (2) merit passes at NCE in French and Education, or one merit or lower credit plus at least four (4) relevant subjects in SSC/GCE.
Direct Entry: requires English Language, Mathematics and any other three Arts or Social Science subjects.
Direct Entry: accepts Two 'A' level papers including French at IJMB/NCE, or a minimum of Merit at Diploma in French or with other Arts/Social Science subjects.

Direct Entry: in addition to UTME requirements, DE candidates must have any of: 2 GCE (Advanced Level) credit passes one of which must be French; NCE merit pass in French and any other relevant subjects; ND lower credit pass in French and any relevant subjects/HND; IJMB minimum of 9 points in three subjects, one of which must be French.

Direct Entry: accepts Two 'A' passes to include French at IJMB/NCE; General English, Use of English at NCE, Lower Credit in National Diploma in addition to 'O' Level requirements; Baccalaureate merit or equivalent from Francophone countries; Alliance Francaise Higher Diploma Upper Level in addition to 'O' Level requirements.

Direct Entry: accepts a) GCE 'A' Level or Baccalaureate equivalent from Francophone countries; b) Merit in French at NCE level; c) DELF B1/B2 or DALF C1/C2; d) Diploma in French (Nigeria French Language Village) in addition to departmental UTME requirements, qualifying the candidate into 200 level.
UTME: requires 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and four (4) other subjects for the 5-year Programme.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in Arts and Social Sciences including French and English Language.
UTME: BSU, DELSU require five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in Literature in English and other Arts or Social Science subject.

UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature in English, Mathematics, Government, History, CRS, Commerce, Agricultural Science or Biology, Geography, Economics and any Nigerian Indigenous Language. Knowledge of French or Spanish is only an advantage but NOT a requirement.

UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in French, English Language, Mathematics, one Science subject from Biology, Health/General Science, Agricultural Science, Physics and Chemistry, or its equivalent of CEF or PIDELF awarded by Alliance Francaise or the Pre-Degree Certificate in French from any recognised University.
UTME: EKSU and UYO accept Proficiency Certificate in French. UYO accepts Proficiency Certificate in French from University of UYO and certificate in French from the Alliance Francaise.
UTME: accepts five (5) or six (6) 'O' Level credit passes at one or two (2) sittings to include Literature in English and other Arts and Social Science subjects.
UTME: accepts English Language, Mathematics and any other three Arts or Social Science subjects.
UTME: accepts Five 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, French and two other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences.
UTME: requires three (3) other Arts subjects.
UTME: requires Five 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any three Arts or Social Sciences. Civic Education and Computer Studies are also accepted.
UTME: accepts NCE merit pass in French.
UTME: 'O' Level credit pass in French is not compulsory.

UTME: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes or its equivalent in English Language, French, and any other three (3) Arts or Social Science subjects, and 'O' Level credit pass in Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings.
UTME: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes or its equivalent in English Language, Government or History and any other three (3) subjects.
UTME: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, French and two (2) other Arts subjects and one Social Science subject.

UTME: UNIZIK, BENIN and OAU accept candidates with no previous knowledge of French. For BENIN, candidates should have 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and Literature in English, while UNIZIK gives accelerated course in French in the first year.

UTME: requires/accepts for a) French Single Honours, minimum five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include French, English Language, one science subject and two (2) other Arts subjects one of which must be Literature in English; b) German Single Honours, minimum five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, one science subject and three (3) other Arts subjects one of which must be Literature in English (Goethe Institute language proficiency certificate an advantage); c) French with German/Russia, 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, French, one science subject and two (2) other Arts subjects one of which must be Literature in English; d) candidates successful in its one year preparatory programme in French, minimum score of 40% plus UTME requirements.
UTME: requires two (2) Arts and Social Science subjects from Economics, Geography, Government, Civic Education, History, Arabic, CRS/IS and any other Nigerian Language.
UTME: accepts Five (5) credit level passes at SSCE/NECO/GCE 'O' Level which may include Mathematics, English Language and four other subjects from Arts and Social Science.

UTME: accepts Five (5) SSC credits in English Language and any other four (4) subjects from French, Literature in English, History/Government, CRK/IRK, Economics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Physics, Igbo/Hausa/Yoruba, Fine Art, Geography, Commerce.
UTME: requires 'O' Level credit passes at GCE, WAEC/SSCE or NECO level in five subjects in the Arts and Social Sciences, including English and Mathematics, at not more than two (2) sittings.
UTME: requires Five 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language and French plus any other Arts or Social Sciences subjects.

UTME: requires Five (5) Credit passes at SSCE, GCE, NECO and NABTEB 'O' Level examination including English Language, Literature in English, Mathematics and two other relevant subjects in not more than two sittings.
UTME Subjects: accepts Literature in English and two (2) other Arts or Social Science subjects.
UTME Subjects: requires Literature in English.
UTME Subjects: accepts any three (3) subjects from Arts, Science or Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: BSU and UNN require French, Literature in English and any other Arts subject.
UTME Subjects: requires Literature in English, CRS and either History or Government.
UTME Subjects: requires two (2) other Arts subjects.
UTME Subjects: accepts English Language and any three Arts or Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: OAU, IBADAN, EKSU, OOU, UNIZIK and ABSU accept any three (3) subjects from Arts and Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: requires Government or History plus any other Arts Subjects.
UTME Subjects: accepts any three (3) Arts or Social Science subject. French is not compulsory.
UTME Subjects: requires one Arts subject and any other two (2) from Arts and Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: requires any three (3) subjects.

UTME Subjects: requires French and any other two (2) subjects from Literature in English, History/Government, CRK/IRK, Economics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Physics, Igbo/Hausa/Yoruba, Fine Art, Geography, Commerce.
UTME Subjects: requires French and any other two (2) Arts subjects.

UTME Subjects: requires English Language and any three from Mathematics, History, Government, Economics, Religious & Cultural Studies, Music, Fine Arts, Commerce, Igbo, Yoruba, Literature in English, Social Studies, Accounting or any other course in Arts and Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: requires English Language and any other three Arts or Social Science Subjects.
UTME Subjects: requires Use of English, French and any other two subjects from Arts or Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: requires French and two other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences.
